newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-PANTANI REPEATS ALPE D'HUEZ TRIUMPH.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-PANTANI REPEATS ALPE D'HUEZ TRIUMPH.

text.p: Italian Marco Pantani won at Alpe d'Huez for the second time when he took the 13th stage of the Tour de France on Saturday.

Pantani, who won a stage at the same Alpine finish in 1995 and missed last year's Tour through injury, climbed impressively and dropped rivals along the arduous final ascent to come in 47 seconds ahead of yellow jersey holder Jan Ullrich.

The German, remarkably strong as he managed to stay in the Italian's slipstream despite not being a mountain specialist, increased his overall lead over Frenchman Richard Virenque, who was third one minute 27 seconds behind Pantani, to six minutes 22 seconds.
Pantani, third overall in 1994, leaped over defending champion Bjarne Riis and Spain's Abraham Olano into third place overall.
